name: New Baby Preparation
description: Provides timeline-anchored preparation checklists for welcoming a new baby, organized into phases: 12 weeks before due date, 4 weeks before, 1 week before, and first week home. Covers medical preparation, home setup, logistics, supplies, and partner/family coordination. Use when the user asks about preparing for a new baby, creating a baby preparation checklist, setting up a nursery timeline, or planning for the postpartum period. Do NOT use for medical advice about pregnancy, diagnosing complications, or replacing guidance from an OB-GYN or midwife.
